title: Does extra sampling budget convert into accuracy, or only into oracle?
pools: REAL N=8 / N=16 / N=32 candidate sets, not subsamples of one pool
VERDICT: Extra budget converts where the probe already has selection skill and is wasted where it does not. radimagenet_open: verifier-greedy +0.1215 -> +0.1932 going 8->32, i.e. +0.0717 more accuracy on one benchmark, comparable to the entire shipped macro. vqamed_open: oracle rises +0.1488 over the same range and the probe converts 1.7% of it. So 'spend more samples where accuracy is lowest' is exactly backwards; spend them where selection skill is positive.
